trajectory_type: Deterministic discrete replay of published captured cameras; sorted by image name, no fabricated orbit

trajectory_rule.slow_test: middle floor(2*N/5) records, advance one captured camera every four simulation frames, loop
trajectory_rule.fast_test: remaining records, advance two captured cameras every simulation frame, loop

statistical_unit: new process block, paired policy sessions
independent_trajectory_limitation: Disjoint recorded views; speed labels are replay strides, not calibrated camera velocity
